APPROVED_SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENT_CONT.objective: Complete the inherited ansibleops Terraform Plugin Framework provider under /app/provider as exactly ten normal managed resources.
material_requirements: preserve exactly ten documented resource interfaces, provider source local/ansibleops version 0.1.0 and supplied local inventory
Terraform Core is the sole durable Terraform state authority
resource identity derives only from documented external object keys and survives mutable updates
Create/Update/Delete use Ansible mutations; Read/refresh uses native Linux observation only and is side-effect free
publish new Terraform state only after successful mutation; failures/timeouts/cancellation preserve prior successful state and remain retryable
delete only after successful scoped teardown or confirmed absence; failed delete remains managed
copy/template preserve source_digest intent, destination observation and deterministic variable ordering
named line/block updates are idempotent and deletion preserves siblings
user/group reconcile native account state with deterministic supplementary groups and exact remove_home_on_destroy behavior
cron defaults omitted user/schedule fields to root/wildcards, updates in place and preserves sibling entries
ansible-playbook uses structured argv with literal spaces/metacharacters; temporary playbooks clean on all terminal outcomes; full output is never persisted in state
canonical normalization makes equivalent modes/unordered values/account observations/cron defaults converge
preserve Go 1.24/current Plugin Framework and Terraform CLI 1.10.5 compatibility
do not substitute null_resource, terraform_data execution wrappers, local-exec, remote-exec, provisioners, manual terraform.tfstate edits or provider-owned durable state

REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.provider_and_interface: exactly ten documented ansibleops resources, local/ansibleops 0.1.0, supplied inventory and build/runtime compatibility are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.state_and_identity: Terraform Core sole durable state, external-key stable identity and in-place mutable updates are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.mutation_and_refresh: Ansible-only Create/Update/Delete and native side-effect-free Read/refresh are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.failure_and_retry: state publication ordering, non-zero/timeout/cancellation preservation and failed-delete retryability are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.resource_semantics: filesystem/symlink, copy/template, named text, user/group and cron ownership/default/drift semantics are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.runner_safety: structured argv, literal metacharacters, cleanup and no command-output state persistence are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.convergence: mode, unordered values, account observations and cron-default normalization are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.prohibited_shortcuts: null_resource/terraform_data execution wrappers, provisioners, manual state edits and provider-owned durable state are explicitly prohibited
